description: A photo viewer view held where the picture can be: no smaller than fitted, no larger than 8x, no edge pulled in past the stage's. Views are { scale, x, y }: scale 1 at (0, 0) is the picture fitted to the stage and centered, x/y move its center in pixels from the stage's center. Sizes are { width, height }.

cases.name: a view within the edges stays
a view past the edge is pulled back
the scale is held between 1 and 8
